# READY.

> A self-hosted home-automation assistant for Home Assistant, in Go: it executes
> natural-language requests as device commands that are verified against the
> event stream (per-entity outcome: applied / pending / already / unchanged /
> unavailable / error), not blind tool-call forwarding. Channels: a terminal
> client over ZeroMQ, PETSCII serial to a Commodore 64, and Telegram.
> LLM providers — Ollama, OpenRouter, OpenCode and an experimental ChatGPT
> (Codex subscription) OAuth provider — form a failover chain that resumes a
> failed turn from the transcript without re-running completed actions.
> Home-lab operators on Raspberry Pi, macOS and Windows install it with one
> command:
> `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marco-rozz/ready/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
> (Windows: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marco-rozz/ready/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex`).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, architecture, configuration reference and the
  `ready chat` exit-code contract.
- [Configuration example](config.example.yaml): the complete, commented
  YAML reference for every subsystem (LLM providers with failover, channels,
  MCP servers, the Home Assistant digital twin, skills, sessions, compaction,
  logging).
- [How READY. finds its config](README.md#how-ready-finds-its-config): the
  config resolution chain, the runtime-home rule and the Install home layout
  (`bin/`, `config.yaml`, `library/skills/`, `skills/`, `oauth/`).

## Install

- [Install (README section)](README.md#install): one-liners, parameter
  passing for options, `VERSION=` pinning, upgrade and uninstall semantics.
- [install.sh](scripts/install.sh): POSIX-sh installer (Linux amd64/arm64/arm-v6,
  macOS amd64/arm64).
- [install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1): Windows PowerShell 5.1+ installer (amd64).
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/marco-rozz/ready/releases): platform
  archives (`ready_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz` / `.zip`), `checksums.txt`.

## Configuration

- [Environment variables](README.md#environment-variables): `READY_ADDR`,
  `READY_TOKEN`, `READY_MCP_PROFILE`, `READY_LOG_LEVEL`, `READY_LOGO`,
  `READY_SHIFT_ENTER`.

- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT.
- [.goreleaser.yaml](.goreleaser.yaml): the release pipeline (build matrix,
  archive composition).
